description: Versioned machine-readable contract for the Harvest management API. Update this file and CHANGELOG.md whenever a route is added, removed, renamed, or its request/response shape changes.

breaking_changes: Changing the type of a response field
Renaming a route (path or method change)
Changing a query parameter from optional to required
Adding a new mutating route without classifying it in this contract
non_breaking_changes: Adding a new optional response field
Adding a new optional query parameter
Adding a new optional request body field
Narrowing an existing error response to be more specific

auth_note: Route authorization posture is classified in issue #174. This contract records the route surface and category; auth enforcement is separate.
audit_note: Mutating routes (read_only: false) are covered by the audit trail (issue #158). The audit endpoint itself is read-only.

routes.description: List workflow executions with optional filters.

params.name: search_attr
params.description: Search attribute filter in key:value form. May be repeated.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

routes.description: Get full details and event history for a single workflow execution.
Export the complete event history for a single execution as a HistoryExportDocument suitable for use as a replay fixture.

params.name: payload_policy
params.description: Payload inclusion policy: full (default), redacted, or omit.

params.name: max_bytes
params.description: Soft byte cap on total payload size.

routes.description: List child workflow executions spawned by a parent execution.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by child status (e.g. Running, Failed). May be repeated.

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum recursion depth for nested children.

routes.description: Show the current wait state of a running workflow (what it is blocked on).
Start a new workflow execution. Idempotent when workflow_id is provided: returns the existing execution if one with the same workflow_id is already running.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent by workflow_id when reuse_policy is reject_duplicate or allow_duplicate_failed_only.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: Stable identifier for idempotent starts.

fields.name: input
fields.description: Workflow input payload (any JSON value).

fields.name: queue
fields.description: Task queue name.

fields.name: memo
fields.description: Non-indexed metadata (JSON object).

fields.name: search_attrs
fields.description: Indexed search attributes (JSON object).

fields.name: execution_timeout_secs
fields.description: Overall execution timeout in seconds.

fields.name: reuse_policy
fields.description: Duplicate-id policy: allow_duplicate, reject_duplicate, allow_duplicate_failed_only, or terminate_if_running.

error_responses.description: Invalid request body or workflow name.
Duplicate workflow_id with conflicting reuse policy.

routes.description: Cancel a running workflow execution.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: cancelling an already-cancelled or terminal execution is a no-op.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Human-readable cancellation reason recorded in audit log.

error_responses.description: Execution is already in a terminal state.

routes.description: Fork a workflow execution at a specific event boundary, replaying from that point with a new execution ID.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: each call forks the execution and creates a distinct new execution ID.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: When true, return the preview without creating a new execution.

fields.name: reset_to_event_id
fields.description: Event sequence number to reset to.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason for the reset, recorded in audit log.

fields.name: operator_id
fields.description: Identity of the operator.

fields.name: signal_reapply
fields.description: How to handle buffered signals: drop or buffer.

error_responses.description: Invalid reset point or request body.

routes.description: Send a named signal to a running workflow execution. The request body is the signal payload itself (free-form JSON).
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: each call delivers a distinct signal event to the workflow.

request_body.description: Optional signal payload — the entire body is passed verbatim to the signal handler.

routes.description: Query the current state of a running workflow by invoking a registered query handler.

error_responses.description: Execution not found or query handler not registered.

routes.description: Submit a synchronous update request to a running workflow. Blocks until admitted or completed depending on the wait parameter.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: each call appends a distinct UpdateAdmitted event with a new update_id.

params.name: wait
params.description: admitted — return when validated; completed — block until handler returns (default).

fields.name: input
fields.description: Payload passed to the update handler (any JSON value).

error_responses.description: Execution not found or update handler not registered.

routes.description: Poll the result of a previously admitted workflow update.
List all registered DAGs and their current pause/enabled state.
List run history for a specific DAG.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of runs to return.

routes.description: Manually trigger a DAG run outside its schedule.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: each call starts a new DAG run.

fields.name: conf
fields.description: Run configuration passed to the DAG (any JSON value).

error_responses.description: DAG is paused or at max_active_runs.

routes.description: Update mutable DAG configuration fields (currently: pause/unpause).
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: applying the same pause state twice is a no-op.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: true to pause the DAG, false to resume it.

routes.description: List dead-lettered tasks that have exhausted all retry attempts.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

routes.description: Bulk-replay dead-lettered tasks matching the provided filters by re-enqueuing them.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent by filter: already-replayed or already-pending entries are skipped.

fields.name: activity_name
fields.description: Filter by activity function name.

fields.name: workflow_name
fields.description: Filter by workflow name.

fields.name: failed_after
fields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only replay entries failed after this time.

fields.name: failed_before
fields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only replay entries failed before this time.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum number of entries to replay.

fields.name: dry_run
fields.description: When true, return a preview without re-enqueuing.

routes.description: Bulk-discard dead-lettered tasks matching the provided filters, removing them from the DLQ permanently.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent by filter: already-discarded entries are skipped.

fields.name: activity_name
fields.description: Filter by activity function name.

fields.name: workflow_name
fields.description: Filter by workflow name.

fields.name: failed_after
fields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only discard entries failed after this time.

fields.name: failed_before
fields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only discard entries failed before this time.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum number of entries to discard.

fields.name: dry_run
fields.description: When true, return a preview without deleting.

routes.description: Replay a single dead-lettered task by re-enqueuing it.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: replaying an already-replayed entry is a no-op.

routes.description: Complete an external activity identified by its task token, supplying the success output.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: completing an already-resolved token returns 404.

params.name: token
params.description: Opaque task token issued when the activity was scheduled.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Result value passed back to the workflow (any JSON value).

error_responses.description: Token not found or already completed.

routes.description: Fail an external activity, optionally marking the error as retryable.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: failing an already-resolved token returns 404.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Error message string.

fields.name: retryable
fields.description: true to schedule a retry (default: false).

routes.description: Send a liveness heartbeat for an in-progress external activity, optionally extending the deadline.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: repeated heartbeats extend or maintain the deadline.

fields.name: extend_by_secs
fields.description: Seconds to extend the activity deadline.

routes.description: List registered worker processes and their current lifecycle status.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by lifecycle status: Active, Draining, or Stopped.

params.name: health
params.description: Filter by health: healthy or stale.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of workers to return [1–500].

routes.description: Get details for a single worker process.
Return aggregated fleet health statistics (active, stale, draining, stopped counts per shard).
Preview which workers would be targeted by a drain request, without modifying anything.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of workers to preview.

routes.description: Request a graceful drain for a specific worker. Sets its status to Draining so it stops accepting new tasks.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: re-draining an already-draining worker extends the deadline if the new one is later.

fields.name: deadline_at
fields.description: RFC 3339 drain-by deadline. Omit to use the server's configured shutdown timeout.

routes.description: List submitted batch operations and their current progress.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of operations to return.

routes.description: Submit a fleet-wide batch operation (Cancel, Terminate, or Signal) targeting workflows matching a filter.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent by idempotency_key when provided: re-submitting with the same key returns the existing batch_job_id.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Batch action: Cancel, Terminate, or Signal.

fields.name: filter
fields.description: Workflow filter (JSON object with states, workflow_name, search attributes).

fields.name: signal_name
fields.description: Signal name — required when action is Signal.

fields.name: signal_payload
fields.description: Signal payload for Signal actions (any JSON value).

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.description: Operator-supplied idempotency token; re-submitting with the same key returns the existing job.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Optional caller identity for audit.

error_responses.description: Invalid action or missing required fields.

routes.description: Get the current status and progress of a batch operation.
Liveness health check. Returns 200 when the plugin is reachable. Does not probe the database.
Run deployment readiness preflight checks: database connectivity, migration status, shard health, and worker coverage.
Return per-shard readiness: ready, degraded, or unavailable.

params.name: candidate_shard
params.description: Shard ID of a new shard to probe before enabling writes.

params.name: fail_on_unready
params.description: When true, the response uses HTTP 503 if any shard is not ready.

error_responses.description: One or more shards not ready (only when fail_on_unready is true).

routes.description: Report recorded workflow version-gate usage.

params.name: state_group
params.description: Execution state group: active or terminal.

routes.description: Check whether a version-gate change ID is safe to retire.

params.name: min_safe_version
params.description: Versions strictly below this value are considered old branches.

params.name: workflow_name
params.description: Narrow to a specific workflow name.

routes.description: Return the current status of the retention janitor.
Trigger the retention janitor to run immediately outside its scheduled interval.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: triggering an already-running retention janitor is a no-op.

routes.description: Return per-activity concurrency statistics: configured cap, currently in-flight, and queued counts for each concurrency key.
Batch-export event histories for multiple executions matching the provided filters.

params.name: state_group
params.description: Execution state group: active or terminal.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — include executions updated after this time.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — include executions updated before this time.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of histories to export.

params.name: payload_policy
params.description: Payload inclusion: full, redacted, or omit.

routes.description: List pending external activity handoffs with optional filters.

params.name: due_before
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only return handoffs due before this time.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only return handoffs last updated before this time.

routes.description: Get the current state and metadata of a single external activity handoff.
List all workflow and DAG schedules.
Create a new cron or interval schedule for a workflow.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: each call creates a new schedule row.

fields.name: workflow_name
fields.description: Registered workflow name.

fields.name: schedule_expr
fields.description: Cron expression (e.g. '0 * * * *').

fields.name: input
fields.description: Workflow input payload (any JSON value).

fields.name: max_active_runs
fields.description: Maximum concurrent scheduled runs.

fields.name: catchup
fields.description: Whether to backfill missed runs.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Create the schedule in paused state.

error_responses.description: Invalid cron expression or missing required fields.

routes.description: Pause a schedule, preventing it from triggering new runs.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: pausing an already-paused schedule is a no-op.

routes.description: Resume a paused schedule.
routes.idempotency: Idempotent: resuming an already-active schedule is a no-op.

routes.description: Delete a schedule. In-flight runs started by this schedule continue to completion.
routes.idempotency: Not idempotent: a second call after successful deletion returns 404.

routes.description: Browse the audit trail of management API mutations. Read-only — the audit log itself is never mutated through this surface.

params.name: target_type
params.description: Filter by target resource type (e.g. workflow, schedule).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by outcome: succeeded or failed.

params.name: since
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only return records after this time.

params.name: before
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — only return records before this time.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.
